_source: App Store Connect API v1 answers for GET /v1/apps (fields name,bundleId) and its 401/403 error documents, in Apple's published shapes (developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi). Ids, names and bundle ids are fictional.

errors.title: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.
errors.detail: Provide a properly configured and signed bearer token, and make sure that it has not expired. Learn more about Generating Tokens for API Requests https://developer.apple.com/go/?id=api-generating-tokens

errors.title: This request is forbidden for security reasons
errors.detail: The API key in use does not allow this request

errors.title: The request rate limit has been reached.
errors.detail: We've received too many requests for this API. Please wait and try again or slow down your request rate.
